` [Highlight start] It is best to avoid mixing melatonin and alcohol [Highlight end] ` . Combining them increases drowsiness and can worsen sleep quality rather than improve it.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScQHEIkXX_dY07jaKGfBdAJgxBoogXI9l4q7HZTfjbH5NE69Owx-EB-Qe7t_zkF5hRjT1-nNZfMPhewtettMSeO4T2KcfGRu752VecpeQn5Ssw5m0byW-Quckgj9pOnjuJsJrh5K171YEmUbRAiyv6aHf)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScgHEIkXXgP8LjaD3synFog7tNbGBHNsAwV5YUYSIcbAytYgZzUC9ebvdhxHC3rAMqxx1PHb2196teifk1wCkrO7Jkjzikm9SweydDyTaDqP_ieUSR-uWNHKgAsYqVyUi3TUy8E-otA2Dsva-BbWpjCYKaw)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESegHEIkXXic2PDl0gGUDYtDPZaptRSbZdgUd5ZCRrpKN2_FJ6VJmJbhry8myKHtpzT_qCmmji9qQiawP-NOe8FSCiXMXmdBgYiBGxYk-2Ary7dpA3cPjD7cpU8FEfwWLOWiiqQJCogql2JSxhC_Q1rlEd6AZ_qPNzM_S9)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHEIkXXBgN9sdgxmpumMeltgMbeae0bWaX8fEIqjWOaIl3UfWC_vfRmBdxuYaCk4RDrnUbsE1tYu3RvQj9VQfEnBzLAv74V8tiQjvvBnZ7zxWkuupRNrEabEjNZqjEN9b5Zicmf)

### Key Risks and Effects

- **Heightened sedation:** Both substances slow central nervous system activity, which can cause excessive drowsiness, dizziness, grogginess, impaired thinking, or trouble waking up.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScgHEIkXXgP8LjaD3synFog7tNbGBHNsAwV5YUYSIcbAytYgZzUC9ebvdhxHC3rAMqxx1PHb2196teifk1wCkrO7Jkjzikm9SweydDyTaDqP_ieUSR-uWNHKgAsYqVyUi3TUy8E-otA2Dsva-BbWpjCYKaw)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESegHEIkXXic2PDl0gGUDYtDPZaptRSbZdgUd5ZCRrpKN2_FJ6VJmJbhry8myKHtpzT_qCmmji9qQiawP-NOe8FSCiXMXmdBgYiBGxYk-2Ary7dpA3cPjD7cpU8FEfwWLOWiiqQJCogql2JSxhC_Q1rlEd6AZ_qPNzM_S9)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScQHEIkXX_dY07jaKGfBdAJgxBoogXI9l4q7HZTfjbH5NE69Owx-EB-Qe7t_zkF5hRjT1-nNZfMPhewtettMSeO4T2KcfGRu752VecpeQn5Ssw5m0byW-Quckgj9pOnjuJsJrh5K171YEmUbRAiyv6aHf)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESggEBxCJF1xdd1y1vsoOo98pB5za9TohjW8-GSTRa1dpugZjuyZ4C2UOh17O1t0bjiR9MhuqyqxCFdFTLz_ur2h_B27262Sy54B7I9PeIRe0msFBIyaY9K9UKVVzhdnfzZwgIoWqBxM8uHyqhStorbtakrquq16Z6lQssC7xb6n-YRAIH)
- **Worse sleep architecture:** Alcohol suppresses REM sleep and causes nighttime awakenings, and melatonin does not reliably fix alcohol-disrupted sleep.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScQHEIkXX_dY07jaKGfBdAJgxBoogXI9l4q7HZTfjbH5NE69Owx-EB-Qe7t_zkF5hRjT1-nNZfMPhewtettMSeO4T2KcfGRu752VecpeQn5Ssw5m0byW-Quckgj9pOnjuJsJrh5K171YEmUbRAiyv6aHf)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXXXy0fZkmQTwWRVDuRlP9TQOjrm58OIyLvsS5YO9E_WkACFZ8QKicI5Kya0mDu0sGR1mgVXDA5bEEYbANl3Nu7-6KccfhBe-TOKLLWLT7epRDLvirw7-y4S3luI-eWzhx-EFLbKzB5)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHEIkXXBgN9sdgxmpumMeltgMbeae0bWaX8fEIqjWOaIl3UfWC_vfRmBdxuYaCk4RDrnUbsE1tYu3RvQj9VQfEnBzLAv74V8tiQjvvBnZ7zxWkuupRNrEabEjNZqjEN9b5Zicmf)
- **Breathing and fall risks:** Relaxed airway muscles can worsen snoring or sleep apnea, and extra sedation raises fall risks—especially for older adults.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESggEBxCJF1xdd1y1vsoOo98pB5za9TohjW8-GSTRa1dpugZjuyZ4C2UOh17O1t0bjiR9MhuqyqxCFdFTLz_ur2h_B27262Sy54B7I9PeIRe0msFBIyaY9K9UKVVzhdnfzZwgIoWqBxM8uHyqhStorbtakrquq16Z6lQssC7xb6n-YRAIH)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESegHEIkXXic2PDl0gGUDYtDPZaptRSbZdgUd5ZCRrpKN2_FJ6VJmJbhry8myKHtpzT_qCmmji9qQiawP-NOe8FSCiXMXmdBgYiBGxYk-2Ary7dpA3cPjD7cpU8FEfwWLOWiiqQJCogql2JSxhC_Q1rlEd6AZ_qPNzM_S9)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXXXy0fZkmQTwWRVDuRlP9TQOjrm58OIyLvsS5YO9E_WkACFZ8QKicI5Kya0mDu0sGR1mgVXDA5bEEYbANl3Nu7-6KccfhBe-TOKLLWLT7epRDLvirw7-y4S3luI-eWzhx-EFLbKzB5)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXXg1AOKgNJVNu4aCPzV3kwiyuy-ar5jBipFJFOsl4apx1lB3wTwjikFUuiHUwafFj5SanXojQg_Bz9b_DXNpf5TC-Th5A8Cw18ZXpnWTTnonLCVUthv1jb3bf0Plrp8thKvtcH15t8)
- **Other possible side effects:** People occasionally report headaches, anxiety, vivid dreams, or stomach upset.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXXg1AOKgNJVNu4aCPzV3kwiyuy-ar5jBipFJFOsl4apx1lB3wTwjikFUuiHUwafFj5SanXojQg_Bz9b_DXNpf5TC-Th5A8Cw18ZXpnWTTnonLCVUthv1jb3bf0Plrp8thKvtcH15t8)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScgHEIkXXgP8LjaD3synFog7tNbGBHNsAwV5YUYSIcbAytYgZzUC9ebvdhxHC3rAMqxx1PHb2196teifk1wCkrO7Jkjzikm9SweydDyTaDqP_ieUSR-uWNHKgAsYqVyUi3TUy8E-otA2Dsva-BbWpjCYKaw)

For more details on potential side effects and label guidance, see the [Sleep Foundation](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESegHEIkXXic2PDl0gGUDYtDPZaptRSbZdgUd5ZCRrpKN2_FJ6VJmJbhry8myKHtpzT_qCmmji9qQiawP-NOe8FSCiXMXmdBgYiBGxYk-2Ary7dpA3cPjD7cpU8FEfwWLOWiiqQJCogql2JSxhC_Q1rlEd6AZ_qPNzM_S9) and [Healthline](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScgHEIkXXgP8LjaD3synFog7tNbGBHNsAwV5YUYSIcbAytYgZzUC9ebvdhxHC3rAMqxx1PHb2196teifk1wCkrO7Jkjzikm9SweydDyTaDqP_ieUSR-uWNHKgAsYqVyUi3TUy8E-otA2Dsva-BbWpjCYKaw) . On [Reddit](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmgEBxCJF121Zmm89X-ygOM2S7yfyzTQOLLSJlzgT-a3awmEiiGxqeSi-k49r4xHvhezw_ELyazM_ykZFml1cAbw10xXPvZwKWWNK-bpG11T2ZzGHIgzu2Y1h1pshOjJIx3tOUs_Wwr-tPIYCPEtk0NKb0GO9fP1D36HcP--9p0Ho00RvOQqH_7zdNrQJeLL40pHyGzj39WlzRcFf) , opinions are mixed: many users warn against combining them due to next-day grogginess or disrupted sleep, while a few suggest a low dose with a couple of drinks feels mild since melatonin is naturally produced in the body.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESegHEIkXXic2PDl0gGUDYtDPZaptRSbZdgUd5ZCRrpKN2_FJ6VJmJbhry8myKHtpzT_qCmmji9qQiawP-NOe8FSCiXMXmdBgYiBGxYk-2Ary7dpA3cPjD7cpU8FEfwWLOWiiqQJCogql2JSxhC_Q1rlEd6AZ_qPNzM_S9)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScgHEIkXXgP8LjaD3synFog7tNbGBHNsAwV5YUYSIcbAytYgZzUC9ebvdhxHC3rAMqxx1PHb2196teifk1wCkrO7Jkjzikm9SweydDyTaDqP_ieUSR-uWNHKgAsYqVyUi3TUy8E-otA2Dsva-BbWpjCYKaw)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmgEBxCJF121Zmm89X-ygOM2S7yfyzTQOLLSJlzgT-a3awmEiiGxqeSi-k49r4xHvhezw_ELyazM_ykZFml1cAbw10xXPvZwKWWNK-bpG11T2ZzGHIgzu2Y1h1pshOjJIx3tOUs_Wwr-tPIYCPEtk0NKb0GO9fP1D36HcP--9p0Ho00RvOQqH_7zdNrQJeLL40pHyGzj39WlzRcFf)

### Practical Guidance

- **If you drink:** Skip your melatonin dose that night and wait until you have been alcohol-free for about 24 hours before taking it again.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScQHEIkXX_dY07jaKGfBdAJgxBoogXI9l4q7HZTfjbH5NE69Owx-EB-Qe7t_zkF5hRjT1-nNZfMPhewtettMSeO4T2KcfGRu752VecpeQn5Ssw5m0byW-Quckgj9pOnjuJsJrh5K171YEmUbRAiyv6aHf)
- **If you take melatonin:** Because melatonin typically clears the body in roughly 5 to 10 hours, some guidance suggests waiting at least a few hours after a nighttime dose before having a drink the next day—though avoiding alcohol when managing sleep is generally more effective.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScQHEIkXX_dY07jaKGfBdAJgxBoogXI9l4q7HZTfjbH5NE69Owx-EB-Qe7t_zkF5hRjT1-nNZfMPhewtettMSeO4T2KcfGRu752VecpeQn5Ssw5m0byW-Quckgj9pOnjuJsJrh5K171YEmUbRAiyv6aHf)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScgHEIkXXgP8LjaD3synFog7tNbGBHNsAwV5YUYSIcbAytYgZzUC9ebvdhxHC3rAMqxx1PHb2196teifk1wCkrO7Jkjzikm9SweydDyTaDqP_ieUSR-uWNHKgAsYqVyUi3TUy8E-otA2Dsva-BbWpjCYKaw)
- **Check medications:** Melatonin can interact with certain drugs (such as blood thinners, immunosuppressants, diabetes medications, or birth control), so check with a pharmacist or doctor if you take regular medications.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScgHEIkXXgP8LjaD3synFog7tNbGBHNsAwV5YUYSIcbAytYgZzUC9ebvdhxHC3rAMqxx1PHb2196teifk1wCkrO7Jkjzikm9SweydDyTaDqP_ieUSR-uWNHKgAsYqVyUi3TUy8E-otA2Dsva-BbWpjCYKaw)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESggEBxCJF1xdd1y1vsoOo98pB5za9TohjW8-GSTRa1dpugZjuyZ4C2UOh17O1t0bjiR9MhuqyqxCFdFTLz_ur2h_B27262Sy54B7I9PeIRe0msFBIyaY9K9UKVVzhdnfzZwgIoWqBxM8uHyqhStorbtakrquq16Z6lQssC7xb6n-YRAIH)

Are you asking for **tonight** after having a drink, or looking for **sleep options** that don't interact with alcohol? Sharing any **regular medications** can also help me tailor this information.

items.title: Practical Guidance
items.text: If you drink: Skip your melatonin dose that night and wait until you have been alcohol-free for about 24 hours before taking it again. If you take melatonin: Because melatonin typically clears the body in roughly 5 to 10 hours, some guidance suggests waiting at least a few hours after a nighttime dose before having a drink the next day—though avoiding alcohol when managing sleep is generally more effective. Check medications: Melatonin can interact with certain drugs (such as blood thinners, immunosuppressants, diabetes medications, or birth control), so check with a pharmacist or doctor if you take regular medications.
